proposition: For about five years, until his death in Herat, he wandered northern and northwestern Iran seeking a livelihood, teaching hadith and tafsir in local mosques and writing treatises for governors and amirs.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II (1431-32), addressed to Bāysunghur
mediation.note: written to seek intercession from the ruler's son while his case was still unresolved
